cover.desc: Full color, Layer 3 palette — cel shading, hard-edged shadows, bright pastel field, generous negative space. Low angle, warm daylight. Kusaka Hibiki mid-leap toward the reader off a stadium rail, both palms open and thrown forward as if he intends to high-five the entire audience, mouth wide open in a shout, bandage across his nose, blazer flapping open over a dark club jersey with a big pale 0 on it, sneakers with crushed heels. His solid black spiked hair is the darkest mass in the frame with hard white highlight bands. Behind and above him, calm and vertical and entirely still, Anzai Sumire stands on the rail he just jumped from — near-white ponytail like a blade, high collar buttoned to the throat, jersey open, long sleeves pulled down over both hands, looking down at him with no expression at all. Around them, a wash of flat pastel crowd shapes and a hanging banner. Bottom corner, small: a plain white card, face up, blank.

panels.bg: Tōka Municipal High School's practice Pit — a floodlit concrete bowl sunk into the sports ground, safety rail, packed bleachers, a school banner, one very tired brass band; tone-washed with a few hard perspective lines
panels.action: Spring welcome exhibition, third minute, and something enormous is already loose down there.

dialogue.text: That's a BULK on the floor, folks!
Karimono Club welcome match, leg one!
IT'S OUT! IT'S ON THE FLOOR!
Four minutes in and it is LOOSE!

chars.name: tetsu
chars.pose: both feet planted wide in the dirt, shoulders squared, arms up, catching something four times his size

panels.bg: the Pit floor, dust, floodlight glare
panels.action: Ōgami Tetsuji stops a two-ton animal with his face and both feet.

dialogue.text: Nothing on earth shifts that boy!

chars.name: tetsu
chars.pose: immovable, heels dug in, the Bulk grinding against him

panels.action: Anchored, he cannot be moved. Anchored, he also cannot move.

chars.name: koharu
chars.pose: clipboard up, pen moving, not looking at the fight

panels.bg: the team box at the rail, tone-washed
panels.action: The manager is not watching. The manager is counting.

chars.name: koharu
chars.expression: pen down, mouth to the collar radio
chars.pose: one hand raised toward the floor

panels.action: She calls it in the flat voice of someone who is never wrong.

chars.name: sumire
chars.pose: walking forward at an unhurried pace, sleeves pulled down over both hands, ponytail hanging straight

panels.bg: Pit floor, the Bulk grinding against Tetsu in the background
panels.action: The ace does not run. The ace announces.

dialogue.text: Then I kick it in the throat.

chars.name: tetsu
chars.pose: still anchored, head turned to the club box

panels.action: Everyone in the building knows what she just did.

dialogue.text: SHE MEANS IT! SHE ALWAYS MEANS IT!

chars.name: sumire
chars.expression: eyes open now, pale iris, one hard catchlight
chars.pose: counting steps under her breath

panels.action: Nine. Ten.

dialogue.text: One step off and it ALL fails!

chars.name: sumire
chars.pose: eleventh step landing, body torqued, one leg coming up and through in a straight kick

panels.bg: the Bulk's head snapping back, dust ring blowing outward
panels.action: Exactly as declared. Nothing in the Pit can argue with exactly.

dialogue.text: SHE CALLED IT TO THE STEP!

chars.name: tetsu
chars.pose: still planted, arms empty now, the Bulk gone past him

panels.bg: the Pit, crowd shapes above the rail
panels.action: The bleachers come apart.

dialogue.text: Leg one, Tōka! A club record!

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: eyes enormous, mouth wide open, radiant
chars.pose: standing on his bleacher seat, both arms straight up, blazer flapping

panels.bg: packed student bleachers, everyone else seated, tone-washed crowd mass
panels.action: One first-year is standing. Only one.

dialogue.text: THAT WAS THE COOLEST THING EVER
SHE TOLD HIM SHE'D DO IT FIRST!
AND THEN SHE JUST DID IT!

chars.name: hibiki
chars.pose: gripping the shoulder of the boy beside him with a bare hand, shaking him

chars.name: student
chars.pose: trying to become smaller

panels.action: He grabs a total stranger. Skin to skin. He does this constantly.

dialogue.text: Let go of my neck, please.

panels.bg: flat white field, borderless with tone fade-out
panels.action: The card. It arrives the instant skin meets skin, and it never announces itself.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.pose: leaning into the stranger's personal space

chars.name: student
chars.pose: clutching his own bag

panels.action: He says it out loud. He always says it out loud.

chars.name: student
chars.pose: already three seats away

chars.name: hibiki
chars.pose: leaning after him

panels.action: Every school gets one of these.

dialogue.text: You're the one with no ability.

panels.bg: the practice Pit from above — the sunken bowl, the safety rail, the club's folding table at the top of the stairs with a hand-painted banner, staff bustling between legs
panels.action: Between legs. The recruiting table opens.

dialogue.text: Five minutes to leg two, folks!
They have nine. They need ten.
They've had nine for four years.

chars.name: koharu
chars.expression: dead flat, glasses two white discs
chars.pose: seated behind the folding table, clipboard vertical, pen poised

panels.bg: the table, a stack of forms nobody has taken
panels.action: Manaka Koharu has taken zero forms in two hours and has counted them all anyway.

chars.name: koharu
chars.expression: flat, holding a form out at a passing student
chars.pose: arm extended without hope

panels.action: The pitch has not been workshopped.

dialogue.text: by an animal for your school.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.pose: vaulting the stair rail at full speed toward the table

panels.action: Impact incoming.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: chibi, sparkling, both hands flat on the table
chars.pose: leaning all the way across into her face

chars.name: koharu
chars.expression: chibi, dot eyes, leaning back exactly as far
chars.pose: clipboard raised like a shield

panels.action: The forms go everywhere.

dialogue.text: How do I get to kick things?!

chars.name: koharu
chars.pose: straightening the forms into a stack

chars.name: hibiki
chars.pose: seated backwards on a folding chair

panels.action: Three boxes. That is the whole form.

chars.name: koharu
chars.pose: eyes up over the glasses

panels.action: Pen ready.

dialogue.text: None at all! Do I still qualify?

chars.name: hibiki
chars.pose: shrugging enormously

panels.bg: the table, wind moving the banner
panels.action: He has said this sentence three hundred times and it has never once cost him a night's sleep.

dialogue.text: I score zero. It's on my file.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: grinning, thumb jerked at the whole stadium
chars.pose: half out of the chair

panels.action: He answers like it's obvious. To him it is.

chars.name: koharu
chars.expression: chibi, dot eyes, one drop of sweat
chars.pose: writing NULL in the box very slowly

panels.action: She writes it. She does not understand it yet.

dialogue.text: We have never recruited a Null.

chars.name: hebihara
chars.expression: sunglasses on her head, unlit cigarette, unimpressed
chars.pose: arriving behind Koharu with a tracksuit jacket over one shoulder

chars.name: koharu
chars.pose: handing over the form

panels.bg: the table, the Pit rail behind
panels.action: The coach reads the form in about a second and a half.

chars.name: hebihara
chars.pose: reading the name box

panels.action: She reads the name box twice.

dialogue.text: I have heard that surname before.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.pose: hand out for a handshake, arm fully extended

chars.name: hebihara
chars.pose: not taking it

panels.action: He offers. She doesn't.

dialogue.text: Put it away. I know what you are.
They say you raced pro, Coach!

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: genuinely startled — the first time all day
chars.pose: hand still out, frozen

panels.action: Nobody has ever said that to him before.

dialogue.text: Four of you in the country. Maybe five.
I raced one. Nine years back.

chars.name: hebihara
chars.expression: half a smile, chewing the unlit cigarette
chars.pose: walking away already, one hand raised in a lazy wave

panels.bg: the stairs down to the team box
panels.action: She does not stop walking.

panels.bg: the Pit floor from the announcer's box — a steel drum on a tripod at the start line, two teams in the boxes, floodlights, the mouth of the Pit like a black square cut into the wall
panels.action: Leg two. The drum spins.

dialogue.text: First-years, this is the whole sport!
We spin the drum. We pull a card.
Nobody knows what's on it. Nobody!
Not the teams. Not me. Nobody!

panels.bg: a gloved official's hand holding a plain white card, flat tone behind
panels.action: The card comes out.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: mouth open, hands on the rail
chars.pose: hanging half over the safety rail

chars.name: student
chars.pose: seated beside him again

panels.action: The stands start arguing immediately. This is most of the fun.

dialogue.text: That's not a thing! Not an object!
A new bell. Still in the box.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: chibi, stars in both eyes, gripping the boy's blazer
chars.pose: shaking him again

chars.name: student
chars.pose: being shaken

panels.action: This is the happiest anyone has been in these bleachers all year.

chars.name: rui
chars.expression: chin up, immaculate, aware of the camera
chars.pose: one hand through his hair at the start line

chars.name: gaku
chars.pose: slouching, arms hanging past his knees

chars.name: momo
chars.pose: bouncing on her toes

panels.bg: the start line, the black mouth of the Pit
panels.action: Six go in at the horn.

dialogue.text: Are we filming? Tell me we're filming.

chars.name: gaku
chars.pose: standing still while both arms stretch three metres up a rock face to hook a ledge

panels.bg: Pit floor one — pale broken stone, drifting dust, tone-washed with two hard perspective lines
panels.action: Hozumi Gaku does not run anywhere. Hozumi Gaku arrives.

dialogue.text: I am going to quit this afternoon.

chars.name: shiho
chars.pose: kneeling, calmly licking a fragment of grey metal

panels.action: Uwabami Shiho identifies materials the only way she knows.

dialogue.text: But I taste the crack. Discard.
Bring me the next one, dear.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: hands clamped on his own face, radiant horror
chars.pose: leaning over the rail

panels.action: He has found his people and does not know it yet.

dialogue.text: SHE LICKED IT AND IT WORKED

chars.name: student
chars.pose: leaning away

chars.name: hibiki
chars.pose: standing on the seat

panels.action: Warnings do not work on this boy.

chars.name: sumire
chars.pose: walking a straight line through the chaos, hands in her sleeves, touching nothing

panels.bg: Pit floor, teammates scrambling around her
panels.action: Everyone else climbs. She walks.

dialogue.text: Anzai hasn't declared once this leg!
She's saving it. She always does.

chars.name: koharu
chars.expression: pen stopped, eyes gone very wide behind the glasses
chars.pose: head snapping up from the clipboard

panels.action: The count is wrong.

chars.name: koharu
chars.expression: standing up so fast the chair goes over
chars.pose: clipboard dropping, hand to the radio at her collar

panels.action: She has never once been wrong about a number.

dialogue.text: There are nine on the floor.

chars.name: koharu
chars.pose: both hands on the radio, turning toward the stands

chars.name: hebihara
chars.pose: sunglasses coming down

panels.action: Two of them went the wrong way.

dialogue.text: COACH. TWO CAME UP THE STAIR.

panels.bg: the spectator gate at the top of the bleachers — a service door slamming open, two low grey shapes coming through into the packed stands
panels.action: Two Litter. In the seats. Where the crowd is.

chars.name: tetsu
chars.pose: planted at the far end of the Pit floor, both feet anchored, unable to take a single step

panels.bg: Pit floor, sixty metres of open ground between him and the stands
panels.action: The strongest boy in the school is bolted to the ground on the wrong side of the stadium.

dialogue.text: SIXTY METRES AND I CANNOT MOVE!

chars.name: sumire
chars.expression: eyes wide open — the first crack in the flat face
chars.pose: stopped dead mid-stride, one hand half out of its sleeve, head turned up toward the stands

panels.bg: Pit floor, the bleachers looming above in tone
panels.action: She is forty metres down and in the middle of a stated intention.

dialogue.text: If I turn now, all of it fails.

panels.bg: the bleachers — students climbing over each other away from the gate, bags and shoes everywhere, two grey shapes coming down the aisle
panels.action: Nine seconds is a very long time.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: not smiling — the whole face has gone still and calculating
chars.pose: one hand on the rail, already turning, eyes moving across the crowd

panels.action: He isn't looking at the animals. He's looking at the people.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: eyes moving fast, counting on his fingers
chars.pose: one hand up, ticking off names

panels.bg: borderless, tone fade-out, ghosted faces behind him
panels.action: Since midnight. Skin to skin. The roster is short.

dialogue.text: Mum at the door. Perfect-hair guy.
Sixty seconds each. That is it.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: grinning again, but wrong — too wide, too fast
chars.pose: up on the seat back, one foot on the rail

chars.name: student
chars.pose: half standing

panels.action: Four minutes of being somebody good.

dialogue.text: Four whole minutes of somebody good.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: eyes blazing, mouth open in a shout, absolutely delighted
chars.pose: launched off the rail into open air over the aisle, both arms spread, blazer flying, black hair a solid mass against the floodlights

panels.bg: the bleachers below and behind, floodlight glare, the two grey shapes in the aisle beneath him
panels.action: The weakest student in Tōka High jumps the rail.

dialogue.text: I'M NOT BEING WEIRD! IT HELPS!

chars.name: hebihara
chars.pose: watching him fall, one hand on the rail

chars.name: koharu
chars.pose: both hands over her mouth

panels.action: The coach does not shout for him to stop.

dialogue.text: He weighs nothing! He will die!

panels.bg: the announcer's box, a man standing up out of his chair with the microphone still in his hand
panels.action: Nine hundred people watch a first-year go over a safety rail.

dialogue.text: A STUDENT IS OVER THE RAIL!
SIT DOWN, SON! NOT YOUR JOB!
THAT BOY IS NOT IN A CLUB!

chars.name: student
chars.pose: thrusting a bare palm out over the seat back with three others doing the same

panels.bg: row six of the bleachers, a forest of confused outstretched hands
panels.action: Nine hundred people do not understand the request. Eleven of them comply anyway.

dialogue.text: JUST DO IT! PUT THEM OUT!

panels.bg: a bare palm meeting a bare palm at speed, tone-washed, motion blur
panels.action: He takes every hand he passes. He will need all of them.

dialogue.text: Four in the tank. Make them count.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.pose: landing in the aisle and slapping his palm into a random third-year's palm on the way past

panels.action: First borrow. He does not have time to be picky.

dialogue.text: One minute! You get it back!

panels.action: The card.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: chibi, white-eyed, jaw on the floor
chars.pose: skidding to a halt mid-sprint

panels.action: Sixty seconds. Ticking. Right now.

chars.name: student
chars.pose: pointing at his own perfect hair

chars.name: hibiki
chars.pose: already running again

panels.action: Everyone is proud of something.

dialogue.text: It's registered! It's on my file!
SIR I AM RUNNING AT AN ANIMAL
It is good in humid weather!

chars.name: hibiki
chars.pose: sprinting down the aisle with both arms up, waving, making himself the loudest thing in the stadium

panels.bg: the aisle, the two Litter turning toward him, students scrambling behind
panels.action: Fifty-one seconds of immaculate hair. He uses it the only way it can be used.

dialogue.text: Not a weapon. It's a voice.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.pose: leading both Litter away down the aisle at a dead sprint, arms windmilling

panels.bg: bleachers emptying behind him, row one clearing, the Pit floor far below
panels.action: It isn't a plan. It's bait. He is extremely good at being bait.

dialogue.text: Someone is — someone is LURING them?
He's pulling them off row one!

chars.name: hebihara
chars.pose: arms folded, watching him run

panels.action: The coach has seen this exactly once before.

dialogue.text: And he did not lie about it.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: counting under his breath, teeth bared
chars.pose: vaulting a row of seats, one hand down

panels.action: He counts out loud. He always counts out loud.

dialogue.text: Three people left. Make them good.

chars.name: gaku
chars.expression: alarmed for the first time in his life
chars.pose: hauling himself over the rail from the Pit side, both arms stretched to their full three metres

panels.action: The nearest club member is coming up the wall, arms first.

dialogue.text: You do not even go here!

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: beaming, hand already closing on Gaku's bare wrist
chars.pose: grabbing him as he runs past

chars.name: gaku
chars.expression: dot eyes, mouth a flat line
chars.pose: being grabbed

panels.action: Second borrow. They have never spoken before.
The card.

dialogue.text: OH YES. OH, YES, THIS ONE.
I have wanted arms my whole life.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: pure joy, eyes shut, swinging with everything he has
chars.pose: throwing an enormous haymaker, his right arm suddenly three metres long and completely out of control

panels.bg: the aisle, the two Litter, seats flying
panels.action: Law six: he gets the ability, not the skill.

dialogue.text: Don't SWING it! You AIM it!

chars.name: hibiki
chars.pose: his own three-metre fist arriving back around and hitting him squarely in the face

panels.action: The arm comes all the way around.

dialogue.text: It does that. It always does that.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: chibi, one hand over a swelling eye, thumbs up
chars.pose: flat on his back across three seats

chars.name: gaku
chars.pose: standing over him

panels.action: Sixteen seconds left of the best ability he has ever held.

dialogue.text: Senpai, how do you live like this?

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: chibi, cheerful, holding up both hands
chars.pose: sitting up

chars.name: gaku
chars.pose: leaning back

panels.action: He explains the Law to a man who did not ask.

dialogue.text: Can't! Sixteen seconds! It's the law!

chars.name: hibiki
chars.pose: long arm hooked around a steel seat-frame, hauling himself over a whole row in one pull

panels.bg: bleachers, one Litter cut off behind him
panels.action: He can't fight with it. He can move with it.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: straining, three metres of arm around a small girl's waist
chars.pose: lifting a first-year out of row one and swinging her back over the seats to safety

panels.bg: row one, the aisle, a grey shape closing
panels.action: Row one, cleared, one child at a time.

dialogue.text: Up you go! Sorry about the arm!

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: mouth open, eyes going wide with recognition
chars.pose: arm mid-extension, already beginning to shorten

panels.action: Three. Two.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: resigned mid-air, one eye already swelling
chars.pose: arm snapping back to normal length while he is still hanging from a seat-frame two metres up, dropping

panels.action: Law four: exactly sixty seconds. It has never once waited for him.

dialogue.text: HIS ARMS WENT BACK TO NORMAL!

chars.name: gaku
chars.pose: arms out, three metres too late

panels.action: He lands badly and gets up anyway.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: face down, one eye open, still counting
chars.pose: sprawled across two rows of seating

panels.action: Two people left. He is keeping score.

dialogue.text: Two left. Mum's one of them.

chars.name: koharu
chars.expression: furious, glasses askew, hauling him up by the collar
chars.pose: one small hand fisted in his blazer, the other holding the clipboard

chars.name: hibiki
chars.pose: being hauled

panels.action: The manager has come down four flights of stairs at a dead run.

dialogue.text: You idiot! You have no ability!
You ran four flights for me!

panels.bg: his bare hand closing around her bare wrist, tone-washed, borderless
panels.action: Skin to skin. Third borrow.
The card.

dialogue.text: It sounds like nothing at all.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: eyes going very wide, pupils shrinking — the whole stadium arriving in his head at once
chars.pose: head snapping up, frozen

panels.bg: radial focus lines, tone blown out to white
panels.action: Then it does it.

dialogue.text: All of it. All at once.

panels.bg: the entire stadium seen at once, every object flagged with a hard blunt number floating beside it — seats, bolts, people, shoes, the two grey shapes in the aisle, the black square of the Pit mouth
panels.action: Everything he has looked at, counted, permanently, whether he wants it or not.

dialogue.text: Forty-one bolts. Six of them loose.
How do you live inside this?
All of it. All at once.

chars.name: koharu
chars.expression: staring at him, entirely still, understanding exactly what just happened
chars.pose: wrist still in his hand

panels.action: Nobody has ever said that to her either.

dialogue.text: Nobody's ever been in here with me.
Not once. Not in six years.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: eyes locked on the far side of the stadium, the smile gone
chars.pose: head turned sharply toward the Pit mouth

panels.action: And then the number that's wrong.

dialogue.text: Senpai. You said nine on the floor.
Nine. Plus two up here. Eleven.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: grim, pointing across the whole stadium
chars.pose: arm out, finger aimed at the black square of the maintenance shaft

chars.name: koharu
chars.pose: turning

panels.bg: the far wall, the shaft, tone
panels.action: Twelve.

chars.name: koharu
chars.expression: all the colour gone out of her face
chars.pose: clipboard slipping from her fingers

panels.bg: the shaft in tone behind her, out of focus
panels.action: She has counted for six years. Nobody has ever checked her work.

panels.bg: the maintenance shaft mouth on the Pit floor — something enormous coming out of it low and fast, dust blowing flat, heading straight for the team box where the officials and the injured are
panels.action: Nobody down there is looking at it. Everyone down there is looking at the stands.

chars.name: sumire
chars.expression: eyes forward, jaw set, deliberately not looking behind her
chars.pose: still walking her declared line, arm reaching for the shelf, sleeve over her hand

panels.bg: Pit floor, the shape closing behind her in tone
panels.action: She declared the shelf. She cannot turn around. Not for any reason.

dialogue.text: I said the shelf. I said the shelf.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: working it out at enormous speed
chars.pose: both hands on the rail, leaning out over sixty metres of open air

panels.bg: the rail, the Pit floor far below
panels.action: He can't get down there. He has eleven seconds of counting left and no arms.

dialogue.text: If she turns, all of it fails.
So don't ask her to turn.
So do not ask her to turn.

chars.name: koharu
chars.pose: one hand up, waving uselessly at the box

panels.action: The radio is out. Nine hundred people are screaming.

dialogue.text: Radio's dead — she can't hear us!
The radio is out! It is dead!

chars.name: koharu
chars.pose: reaching as he climbs the rail

chars.name: hibiki
chars.pose: one foot up on the top rail

panels.action: There is exactly one channel left.

dialogue.text: She doesn't know who you ARE—
She just has to trust a number.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: mouth wide open, whole body thrown into it, one hand cupped beside his mouth
chars.pose: standing on the top rail above the entire stadium, tiny against the bowl, black hair a hard black mark on the white sky

panels.bg: the whole Pit from behind and above him — nine hundred people, floodlights, the far wall, Sumire a small white figure on the floor
panels.action: He does not tell her to run. He gives her a number.

dialogue.text: SIX STEPS! IT'S ON YOUR LEFT!
I COUNTED! I PROMISE I COUNTED!

chars.name: koharu
chars.expression: shouting with him, both hands cupped
chars.pose: up on the rail beside him

panels.action: The manager backs a stranger's count with her own name.

panels.bg: the bleachers, nine hundred faces all turned the same way, the brass band standing on their chairs
panels.action: The stadium goes quiet enough for one voice to cross it.

dialogue.text: I have no idea, folks. None.
WHO IS THAT ON THE RAIL?!

chars.name: tetsu
chars.pose: still anchored sixty metres away, both feet in the dirt

panels.bg: Pit floor, dust, the shape coming out of the shaft behind
panels.action: The captain hears a first-year give his ace a firing solution.

dialogue.text: Who is that? WHO IS THAT?

chars.name: hebihara
chars.pose: one hand frozen halfway to her pocket

panels.bg: the team box, floodlight glare, out of focus crowd
panels.action: The coach has waited nine years to watch someone do this.

dialogue.text: That is what a Null is for.

chars.name: sumire
chars.expression: eyes wide, pale iris, one hard catchlight — hearing a voice she does not know
chars.pose: hand closing on the item on the shelf, still facing forward

panels.action: A stranger in the stands has just told her a number. She has no reason on earth to believe it.

dialogue.text: A number. Somebody gave me a number.

chars.name: sumire
chars.expression: eyes closing for a half-second, deciding
chars.pose: fist tightening inside the sleeve

panels.action: They scream at her. They never count for her.

chars.name: sumire
chars.pose: lifting a small tarnished bell off the shelf, still not turning

panels.bg: the shelf, the shape closing behind in tone
panels.action: She finishes exactly what she said she would do. Then, and only then, the next thing.

dialogue.text: SHE HAS THE ITEM! AND SHE IS CALLING!

chars.name: sumire
chars.expression: eyes blazing, teeth bared — the first real expression of the chapter
chars.pose: pivoting on one heel into a full turn, bell in her sleeve-covered fist, other leg already loading

panels.bg: the Bulk arriving, dust wall, floodlight glare
panels.action: Six steps. On the left. Exactly as told.

panels.bg: silhouette panel — two solid black shapes against a flat blown-out tone field: a small figure with one leg extended, and something enormous coming apart around it
panels.action: It is over in under a second.

dialogue.text: SHE CALLED IT AND SHE DID IT!

chars.name: sumire
chars.pose: on one knee in the settling dust, bell held up in a sleeve-covered hand

chars.name: tetsu
chars.pose: arms in the air, jogging over

panels.bg: the Pit floor, dust, floodlights, the whole stadium on its feet
panels.action: Leg two. A bell that has never rung, and it never got the chance.

dialogue.text: Leg two, Tōka! The item is GOOD!
It rang when I hit it.
Let him argue. I will sit on him.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: grinning, filthy, one eye swollen shut
chars.pose: half-falling down the last of the Pit-side stairs onto the floor

panels.action: He has come down four flights on a twisted ankle to say one thing.

dialogue.text: SIX STEPS! IT WAS ACTUALLY SIX!

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: open, warm, entirely unguarded — hand out
chars.pose: skidding to a stop in front of her and offering a bare hand to help her up

chars.name: sumire
chars.pose: still on one knee

panels.bg: dust, tone-washed, the crowd a soft mass above
panels.action: It is the most ordinary gesture in the world.

dialogue.text: That was the best thing ever.

chars.name: sumire
chars.expression: flat, unreadable, eyes on his palm and nowhere else
chars.pose: standing up entirely on her own, one step back, sleeve pulled down past her knuckles

panels.action: She stands up by herself. She takes one step backward.

dialogue.text: I don't do that. Not with anybody.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: hand still out, smile still on, not understanding at all
chars.pose: frozen, arm extended into empty air

panels.action: He has shaken four hundred hands this year. This is the first that ever moved away.

panels.bg: the club shed behind the practice Pit — a converted equipment hut, whiteboard covered in old race cards, a fridge with one melon in it, a sofa with a known hole, gear on every hook, evening light through one window
panels.action: Forty minutes later. The room where this series lives.

dialogue.text: It has four hundred thousand views.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: bandaged, one eye purple, grinning like it's a birthday
chars.pose: sitting bolt upright on the broken sofa, hands on his knees

chars.name: bin
chars.pose: sitting beside him, not moving

panels.action: Nine people are looking at him. He is having the best day of his life.

dialogue.text: You jumped a rail at two animals.
You have no ability at all.

chars.name: bin
chars.expression: completely flat, not looking at him
chars.pose: sliding the headphones back on

panels.action: Numata Bin does not raise his voice, ever.

chars.name: tetsu
chars.expression: arms folded, enormous, serious for once
chars.pose: standing in front of the whiteboard

chars.name: koharu
chars.pose: beside him

panels.bg: the whiteboard, old cards taped in rows
panels.action: The captain does the arithmetic out loud.

dialogue.text: You called a Bulk from four flights up.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.pose: trying to give the credit away

chars.name: koharu
chars.expression: chibi, pushing his hands back down
chars.pose: unimpressed

panels.action: He genuinely does not think it was his.

dialogue.text: That was senpai's! I just held it!
I've never shouted it at anybody.

chars.name: hebihara
chars.expression: sunglasses down now, arms folded, reading the room
chars.pose: leaning in the shed doorway

chars.name: shiho
chars.pose: pouring tea for everyone

panels.bg: the shed, evening light, the whole club packed in
panels.action: The coach explains him to a room that has never met one before.

dialogue.text: One at a time. Skin to skin.

chars.name: hebihara
chars.expression: chewing the unlit cigarette, watching the boy
chars.pose: one shoulder against the door frame

panels.action: She says the sad part like it's a weather report, because he does too.

chars.name: momo
chars.pose: chewing, both hands on the table

chars.name: rai
chars.pose: jacket hanging off both shoulders

panels.action: The room does the maths a beat behind her.

dialogue.text: Wait. Nine of us are in this room.
So he shakes all nine of us?

chars.name: koharu
chars.expression: glasses flashing, pen moving very fast
chars.pose: already writing a formation on the clipboard

panels.action: The manager has been doing this maths since the stairs.

dialogue.text: Nine minutes of the whole club.
In one body. Anywhere on course.

chars.name: tetsu
chars.pose: offering a huge bare palm across the table

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: looking at the hand like it is a birthday cake
chars.pose: half out of his seat

panels.action: The captain offers his hand. Nobody has ever done that on purpose before.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: chibi, sparkling, tears of joy, mid-lunge
chars.pose: going down the line shaking every hand in the room at speed

chars.name: rai
chars.pose: hand caught

chars.name: shiho
chars.pose: offering both hands

panels.action: He works the entire room in eleven seconds.

dialogue.text: You may have both of mine, dear.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: chibi, stars for eyes, both fists up
chars.pose: standing on the sofa

panels.action: Four cards in a row. He reads them all out.

dialogue.text: BEST DAY OF MY WHOLE LIFE
I AM GOING TO BORROW EVERYONE

chars.name: sumire
chars.expression: flat, watching from the far wall
chars.pose: standing apart with her back to the whiteboard, both hands inside her sleeves

chars.name: momo
chars.pose: waving her over

panels.bg: the shed, the noise happening two metres away
panels.action: One person in the room has not moved.

dialogue.text: Anzai! Your turn! Shake his hand!
What? She is on the team.

chars.name: sumire
chars.pose: not moving, hands still in her sleeves

chars.name: hibiki
chars.pose: stopped mid-room

panels.bg: the shed, the room going quiet
panels.action: The room goes quiet in the specific way a room does when this has happened before.

dialogue.text: Do not make it about you.

panels.bg: silhouette panel — a tall solid black figure against a flat pale tone field, arms down, both hands swallowed by sleeves, absolutely closed; a smaller black figure a full two metres away with one hand still half-raised
panels.action: Two metres. The distance this series will spend a hundred chapters on.

dialogue.text: Leave it. She doesn't. Not anyone.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: smile back on, but the eyes are doing something new
chars.pose: lowering his hand slowly and putting it in his pocket

panels.action: For the first time in his life he keeps something to himself.

dialogue.text: One person I can't ever be. Huh.

panels.bg: the shed door banging open from outside, evening light flooding in, three silhouettes in immaculate matching gear standing in it
panels.action: The door does not knock.

chars.name: ayame
chars.expression: pleasant, perfectly polite, eyes doing none of it
chars.pose: stepping into the shed, one hand holding out a sealed white card between two fingers

panels.bg: the doorway, the club frozen around her
panels.action: Kujō Ayame, Seiran Academy, does not raise her voice once.

dialogue.text: Sorry to barge in. Kujō Ayame.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: bright, delighted, entirely himself, hand already out
chars.pose: bouncing forward past the captain with his palm up

chars.name: ayame
chars.expression: glancing down at the hand, amused
chars.pose: taking it without hesitating

panels.action: He does what he always does. She lets him.

dialogue.text: Kusaka Hibiki! Nice to meet you!

chars.name: ayame
chars.expression: smiling with the lower half of her face only
chars.pose: not letting go of his hand

panels.bg: the shed, tone-washed, the others out of focus
panels.action: She did not take his hand by accident.

dialogue.text: They said you'd shake my hand.
Everyone said so. So I let you.
So I let you. Go on. Read it.

panels.bg: flat white field, borderless, the card larger than any card so far
panels.action: The card.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: the grin completely gone — flat, still, and for the first time in twenty-five pages, afraid
chars.pose: hand still locked in hers, not letting go, not able to

panels.bg: flat blown-out tone, everything else gone
panels.action: He has read four hundred cards this year. None of them told him the cost.

dialogue.text: See you in six days, Kusaka-kun.
It told me what it costs.
